prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the kind of work you need (brand/creative, digital/SEO/PPC, B2B demand gen, social, PR, etc.). 

Two widely recognized Kansas City agencies you can consider right away:
- Barkley — known for big-brand creative, integrated campaigns and strategic brand work.
- VML (now VML/VMLY&R) — a large, digitally focused global agency that started in Kansas City; strong on digital, customer experience and integrated marketing.

If you want, I can give a tailored shortlist. Tell me:
- What are your goals (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, local foot traffic, etc.)?
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- Are you a B2B or B2C business and what industry are you in?
- Do you prefer a large full‑service agency or a smaller boutique/specialist?

I can then recommend 3–5 Kansas City agencies that match your needs and explain why each could be a good fit. I can also give a checklist of questions to ask agencies during vetting.
